name: DUST LOVE
source:
Our hero ends up buried in debt after co-signing for a friend.
Meanwhile, he falls hard for a classy older woman he sees every week on trash day.
He keeps turning down shady offers, hoping for some shot at happiness—
—but can he really pull it off?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01037360.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
我们的英雄在与朋友共同签约后最终负债累累。
与此同时，他深深爱上了每周垃圾日都会见到的一位优雅的年长女性。
他不断拒绝不正当的提议，希望能获得一些幸福的机会——
——但他真的能成功吗？
